Everything around us is made of tiny particles. The movement of these particles affects the properties of materials.

Light and Reflection

Light rays reflect off surfaces and bend when passing through lenses, affecting how we see objects.

metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Light and Reflection in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Invisible World Beyond Naked Eye
text:
Invisible World Beyond Naked Eye

Key terms: microscope, invisible world, living beings

There's a hidden world of tiny living beings that we can't see with our naked eyes. Using tools like microscopes, we can explore this world and learn about its inhabitants.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Invisible World Beyond Naked Eye in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Discovery of Microscopic World
text:
Discovery of Microscopic World

Key terms: Robert Hooke, Antonie van Leeuwenhoek, microscope

Scientists like Robert Hooke and Antonie van Leeuwenhoek used microscopes to discover and describe the microscopic world for the first time.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Discovery of Microscopic World in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Cell Structure
text:
Cell Structure

Key terms: cell, cell membrane, cytoplasm, nucleus, cell wall

All living beings are made up of cells. A cell has a cell membrane, cytoplasm, and a nucleus. Some cells, like plant cells, also have a cell wall.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Cell Structure in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Cell Variation
text:
Cell Variation

Key terms: cell variation, cell function, muscle cell, nerve cell

Cells vary in shape, size, and structure, and these differences relate to their functions. For example, muscle cells are spindle-shaped for contraction, while nerve cells are long and branched for message transmission.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Cell Variation in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Levels of Organisation in Living Beings
text:
Levels of Organisation in Living Beings

Key terms: cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism

Living beings are organised at different levels: cells form tissues, tissues form organs, organs form organ systems, and organ systems form the complete organism.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.topic: Levels of Organisation in Living Beings
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Levels of Organisation in Living Beings in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms
text:
Microorganisms

Key terms: microorganisms, unicellular, multicellular

Microorganisms are tiny living beings that can't be seen with the naked eye. They can be unicellular (made of one cell) or multicellular (made of many cells).

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Microorganisms in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganism Structure vs Plant/Animal Cells
text:
Microorganism Structure vs Plant/Animal Cells

Key terms: microorganism, cell structure, microscope

Microorganisms like bacteria and Amoeba have simple cell structures, unlike plant and animal cells which have organelles. They are observed using microscopes due to their small size.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Microorganism Structure vs Plant/Animal Cells in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms in Water and Soil
text:
Microorganisms in Water and Soil

Key terms: microorganism, water, soil, microscope

Microorganisms are found in water, soil, and air. They can be observed using a microscope after collecting samples from these environments.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Microorganisms in Water and Soil in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms in Food Spoilage
text:
Microorganisms in Food Spoilage

Key terms: microorganism, food spoilage, rot

Microorganisms can cause food to rot and spoil. They can be found on surfaces of food items left outside for some time.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Microorganisms in Food Spoilage in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms in Waste Decomposition
text:
Microorganisms in Waste Decomposition

Key terms: microorganism, waste decomposition, recycling

Microorganisms like bacteria and fungi help in decomposing plant and animal waste, recycling nutrients back to the soil, and cleaning the environment.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Microorganisms in Waste Decomposition in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms in Food Production
text:
Microorganisms in Food Production

Key terms: microorganism, food production, yeast, bacteria

Microorganisms like yeast and bacteria are used in food production. Yeast helps in making bread and other baked goods, while bacteria help in making curd and other fermented foods.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Microorganisms in Food Production in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microalgae in Water and Environment
text:
Microalgae in Water and Environment

Key terms: microalgae, water, environment, oxygen production

Microalgae are microscopic plant-like organisms that produce oxygen and serve as a food source for many aquatic animals. They help in cleaning water and producing biofuel.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Microalgae in Water and Environment in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microalgae Benefits and Threats
text:
Microalgae Benefits and Threats

Key terms: Microalgae, Spirulina, Pollution, Climate Change

Microalgae like Spirulina are used as health supplements and medicines, help clean water, and make biofuel. However, pollution, climate change, and habitat destruction threaten their diversity and abundance.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Microalgae Benefits and Threats in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Spirulina Farming
text:
Spirulina Farming

Key terms: Spirulina, Farming, Pond Water, Harvesting

Spirulina can be farmed easily by following steps: setting up a clear glass tank in a bright place, adding pond water and living Spirulina, stirring it twice a week, and harvesting after 3-6 weeks.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Spirulina Farming in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Cell as the Basic Unit of Life
text:
Cell as the Basic Unit of Life

Key terms: Cell, Organisms, Multicellular, Unicellular

All living organisms are made up of tiny building blocks called cells. These cells perform various functions and cooperate with each other in multicellular organisms.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.topic: Cell as the Basic Unit of Life
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Cell as the Basic Unit of Life in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Cell Structures in Microorganisms
text:
Cell Structures in Microorganisms

Key terms: Cell Membrane, Cell Wall, Nucleoid, Chloroplast

Like animal and plant cells, microbial cells are surrounded by a cell membrane. Some have a cell wall, but not all have a well-defined nucleus or chloroplasts.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Cell Structures in Microorganisms in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms in Environment and Health
text:
Microorganisms in Environment and Health

Key terms: Microorganisms, Beneficial, Harmful, Diseases

Microorganisms can be beneficial or harmful. Some decompose waste, while others cause diseases in plants, animals, and humans.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Microorganisms in Environment and Health in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Microorganisms in Food Production
text:
Microorganisms in Food Production

Key terms: Microorganisms, Yeast, Lactobacillus, Food Production

Microorganisms like yeast and lactobacillus are used in food production, such as making bread, cakes, and curd.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Microorganisms in Food Production in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Health: More Than Absence of Disease
text:
Health: More Than Absence of Disease

Key terms: Health, Well-being, Mental Health, Social Health

Health is not just about not having diseases, but also feeling good physically, mentally, and socially. It involves taking care of your body, maintaining a positive mindset, and enjoying social life.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.topic: Health: More Than Absence of Disease
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Health: More Than Absence of Disease in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Lifestyle and Environment Affect Health
text:
Lifestyle and Environment Affect Health

Key terms: Lifestyle, Environment, Health Factors

Our health depends on our lifestyle (how we live) and our environment (our surroundings). Factors like diet, exercise, sleep, stress, and cleanliness play a significant role in maintaining good health.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Lifestyle and Environment Affect Health in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Diseases: Causes and Types
text:
Diseases: Causes and Types

Key terms: Disease, Pathogen, Non-communicable, Communicable

Diseases can be caused by pathogens (like bacteria, viruses) or lifestyle factors. They can be non-communicable (like cancer, diabetes) or communicable (like flu, chickenpox).

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Diseases: Causes and Types in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Preventing Communicable Diseases
text:
Preventing Communicable Diseases

Key terms: Communicable Diseases, Prevention, Hygiene, Vaccination

Communicable diseases can be prevented by maintaining personal hygiene, washing hands, covering mouth while coughing, avoiding close contact with infected people, and getting vaccinated.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Preventing Communicable Diseases in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Non-communicable Diseases: Causes and Effects
text:
Non-communicable Diseases: Causes and Effects

Key terms: Non-communicable Diseases, Causes, Chronic Diseases

Non-communicable diseases are caused by lifestyle, diet, and environment. They can persist for a long time and are the most common cause of death in India.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Non-communicable Diseases: Causes and Effects in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Healthy Habits for a Balanced Life
text:
Healthy Habits for a Balanced Life

Key terms: Healthy Lifestyle, Balanced Diet, Physical Activity, Stress Management

Maintaining a healthy lifestyle includes eating a balanced diet, staying physically active, getting enough sleep, managing stress, and avoiding harmful substances.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.topic: Healthy Habits for a Balanced Life
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Healthy Habits for a Balanced Life in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Clean Environment for Good Health
text:
Clean Environment for Good Health

Key terms: Clean Environment, Health, Air Quality, Water Quality

A clean environment, including clean air and water, is essential for good health. Keeping our surroundings clean helps prevent diseases and promotes well-being.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Clean Environment for Good Health in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Emotional Health Matters Too
text:
Emotional Health Matters Too

Key terms: Emotional Health, Mental Health, Social Health

Our feelings and relationships matter too. Spending time with friends and family, talking, laughing, and having fun help keep our minds healthy.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Emotional Health Matters Too in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Deficiency Diseases
text:
Deficiency Diseases

Key terms: deficiency, nutrients, non-communicable

Diseases caused by lack of specific nutrients in diet, like scurvy, anemia, and goiter. Non-communicable and often preventable.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Deficiency Diseases in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Chronic Diseases
text:
Chronic Diseases

Key terms: chronic, persist, manage

Diseases that persist for a long time, like diabetes, cancer, and asthma. Often managed but not cured.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Chronic Diseases in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Diabetes Causes
text:
Diabetes Causes

Key terms: diabetes, causes, hormonal imbalance

Caused by hormonal imbalances, unhealthy eating, lack of exercise, being overweight, and other factors.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Diabetes Causes in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Vaccines
text:
Vaccines

Key terms: vaccines, immune system, preventive

Preventive measures that train the immune system to fight diseases by using weakened or harmless parts of germs.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Vaccines in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Immunity
text:
Immunity

Key terms: immunity, immune system, fight diseases

Body's natural ability to fight diseases, helped by vaccines and a healthy lifestyle.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Immunity in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Antibiotics
text:
Antibiotics

Key terms: antibiotics, bacteria, resistance

Medicines that kill bacteria, but their overuse leads to antibiotic resistance.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Antibiotics in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Antibiotic Resistance
text:
Antibiotic Resistance

Key terms: resistance, antibiotics, overuse

Bacteria's ability to survive antibiotics, making infections harder to treat. Caused by overuse and misuse of antibiotics.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Antibiotic Resistance in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Health and Happiness
text:
Health and Happiness

Key terms: health, happiness, related

Closely related; good health improves mood, and being happy helps maintain good health.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Health and Happiness in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Analyzing Dengue Case Data
text:
Analyzing Dengue Case Data

Key terms: dengue, cases, trends, prevention

Identify trends and patterns in dengue cases over time, and suggest preventive measures based on the data.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Analyzing Dengue Case Data in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Creating a School Health Campaign
text:
Creating a School Health Campaign

Key terms: health campaign, communicable diseases, non-communicable diseases, key messages

Develop key messages to reduce communicable and non-communicable diseases in a school health campaign.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Creating a School Health Campaign in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Antibiotic Use for Viral Infections
text:
Antibiotic Use for Viral Infections

Key terms: antibiotic, viral infection, cold, cough, flu

Understand why antibiotics should not be taken for viral infections like a cold, cough, or flu.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Antibiotic Use for Viral Infections in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Waterborne Diseases
text:
Waterborne Diseases

Key terms: waterborne diseases, contamination, excreta, infection

Identify diseases that can spread if drinking water gets contaminated by the excreta from an infected person.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Waterborne Diseases in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Immune Response to Pathogens
text:
Immune Response to Pathogens

Key terms: immune response, pathogen, exposure

Explain why the immune response to a pathogen is stronger on subsequent exposures compared to the first exposure.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Immune Response to Pathogens in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Vaccination and Disease Eradication
text:
Vaccination and Disease Eradication

Key terms: vaccination, smallpox, eradication, protection

Understand how vaccination helped eradicate smallpox and debate the importance of vaccination for protecting others.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Vaccination and Disease Eradication in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | CPR Sequence for Adults
text:
CPR Sequence for Adults

Key terms: CPR, adult, sequence, steps

Learn the correct sequence of steps for performing cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) on an adult.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to CPR Sequence for Adults in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Health Card Creation
text:
Health Card Creation

Key terms: health card, creation, information, discussion

Create a health card including relevant information and discuss its contents with peers.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Health Card Creation in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Electric Current's Magnetic Effect
text:
Electric Current's Magnetic Effect

Key terms: electric current, magnetic field, compass needle

Electric current flowing through a wire creates a magnetic field, deflecting a compass needle. This effect was discovered by Hans Christian Oersted.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Electric Current's Magnetic Effect in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Electromagnet
text:
Electromagnet

Key terms: electromagnet, electric current, magnetic poles

A coil of wire carrying an electric current acts like a magnet, attracting iron objects. It has two poles, North and South, like a bar magnet.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Electromagnet in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Heating Effect of Electric Current
text:
Heating Effect of Electric Current

Key terms: electric current, resistance, heating effect

Electric current flowing through a conductor, like a nichrome wire, causes it to heat up due to resistance. This principle is used in various household appliances.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Heating Effect of Electric Current in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Earth's Magnetic Field
text:
Earth's Magnetic Field

Key terms: Earth's magnetic field, electric currents, navigation

Earth behaves like a giant magnet due to electric currents deep inside its core, creating a magnetic field that helps navigation and protects life.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Earth's Magnetic Field in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Lifting Electromagnets
text:
Lifting Electromagnets

Key terms: lifting electromagnets, current, iron objects

Strong electromagnets used in factories and scrap yards to move, lift, and sort heavy metal items by switching the current on and off.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Lifting Electromagnets in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Heating Effect of Electric Current
text:
Heating Effect of Electric Current

Key terms: electric current, heating effect, wire, appliances

Electric current flowing through a wire generates heat, depending on the wire's material, thickness, length, and the duration of the current flow. Many household appliances, like electric heaters and irons, work on this principle.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Heating Effect of Electric Current in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Safety with Heating Effect
text:
Safety with Heating Effect

Key terms: safety, heating effect, injuries

The heating effect of electric current can cause injuries if not handled safely. It's important to avoid touching heated wires for extended periods.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Safety with Heating Effect in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Energy Loss in Wires
text:
Energy Loss in Wires

Key terms: energy loss, wires, transmission

The heating effect of electric current can cause energy loss in wires during transmission, leading to inefficient power transfer.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Energy Loss in Wires in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Voltaic Cell
text:
Voltaic Cell

Key terms: Voltaic cell, Galvanic cell, chemical reaction, electrolyte

A Voltaic cell, also known as a Galvanic cell, generates electricity through a chemical reaction between two different metals and an electrolyte.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Voltaic Cell in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Dry Cells
text:
Dry Cells

Key terms: dry cells, electrolyte, single-use

Dry cells are widely used electric cells with a thick moist paste electrolyte, unlike Voltaic cells which use a liquid electrolyte. They are single-use cells.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Dry Cells in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Rechargeable Batteries
text:
Rechargeable Batteries

Key terms: rechargeable batteries, reusable, environmental benefits

Rechargeable batteries can be recharged and reused multiple times, unlike dry cells. They are increasingly used in various applications due to their convenience and environmental benefits.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Rechargeable Batteries in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Magnetic Effect of Electric Current
text:
Magnetic Effect of Electric Current

Key terms: magnetic effect, electric current, conductor, electromagnet

Electric current flowing through a conductor produces a magnetic field around it, creating a magnetic effect. A current-carrying coil can behave like a magnet, known as an electromagnet.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Magnetic Effect of Electric Current in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Heating Effect in Conductors
text:
Heating Effect in Conductors

Key terms: heating effect, conductors, electric current, appliances

Generation of heat in conductors due to the flow of electric current is known as the heating effect of electric current. This effect is used in various household appliances and industrial applications.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Heating Effect in Conductors in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Electric Cell with Fruits and Vegetables
text:
Electric Cell with Fruits and Vegetables

Key terms: electric cell, electrolyte, electrodes

You can create a simple electric cell using fruits and vegetables as the electrolyte, and different metals as electrodes. This demonstrates the basic principle of an electric cell.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.topic: Electric Cell with Fruits and Vegetables
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Electric Cell with Fruits and Vegetables in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Recycling Batteries
text:
Recycling Batteries

Key terms: recycle, batteries, environment, resources

Even when a battery stops working, it can still contain harmful materials and valuable resources. It's important to recycle batteries to protect the environment and conserve resources.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Recycling Batteries in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Force Definition
text:
Force Definition

Key terms: force, push, pull, interaction

A force is a push or pull on an object resulting from its interaction with another object. It can make an object move, change its speed, direction, or shape.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to remember concepts related to Force Definition in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Contact Forces
text:
Contact Forces

Key terms: contact forces, muscular force, friction

Contact forces are forces that act only when there is physical contact between objects. Examples include muscular force and friction.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Contact Forces in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Friction
text:
Friction

Key terms: friction, contact force, irregularities

Friction is a contact force that opposes the motion between two surfaces in contact. It arises due to the irregularities in the surfaces and depends on the nature of the surfaces.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to apply concepts related to Friction in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Non-Contact Forces
text:
Non-Contact Forces

Key terms: non-contact forces, magnetic force, electrostatic force

Non-contact forces are forces whose effect can be experienced even if the objects are not in contact. Examples include magnetic force and electrostatic force.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to analyze concepts related to Non-Contact Forces in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Magnetic Force
text:
Magnetic Force

Key terms: magnetic force, attract, repel

Magnetic force is a non-contact force that attracts or repels objects made of magnetic materials or magnets. It acts from a distance without physical contact.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to evaluate concepts related to Magnetic Force in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Electrostatic Force
text:
Electrostatic Force

Key terms: electrostatic force, charged object, rubbing

Electrostatic force is a non-contact force that attracts uncharged objects made of certain materials towards a charged object. It occurs when two objects of certain materials are rubbed together.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to create concepts related to Electrostatic Force in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Like Charges Repel, Unlike Attract
text:
Like Charges Repel, Unlike Attract

Key terms: charge, repel, attract, electrostatic force

Similarly charged objects (like) repel each other, while oppositely charged objects (unlike) attract each other. This is due to the force between them, called electrostatic force.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Like Charges Repel, Unlike Attract in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Earth's Gravitational Force
text:
Earth's Gravitational Force

Key terms: gravity, gravitational force, attract

The Earth attracts all objects towards itself with a force called gravity or gravitational force. This force acts without contact and is always attractive.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Earth's Gravitational Force in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Weight as a Measure of Gravity
text:
Weight as a Measure of Gravity

Key terms: weight, gravity, newton

The force with which the Earth pulls an object towards itself is called the weight of the object. Weight is measured in newtons (N) and is a way to quantify the gravitational force acting on an object.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.topic: Weight as a Measure of Gravity
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Weight as a Measure of Gravity in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Weight vs Mass
text:
Weight vs Mass

Key terms: mass, weight, gravitational force

Mass is the amount of matter in an object and remains the same, while weight is the gravitational force acting on an object and can vary from place to place. Mass is measured in grams (g) or kilograms (kg), while weight is measured in newtons (N).

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Weight vs Mass in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Buoyant Force
text:
Buoyant Force

Key terms: buoyant force, upthrust, float, sink

When an object is placed in a liquid, the liquid applies an upward force called buoyant force. If the buoyant force is equal to the weight of the object, it floats; if not, it sinks or floats partially.

metadata.subject: Science
metadata.learning_objective: Students will be able to understand concepts related to Buoyant Force in Grade 8 Science.

title: NCERT Grade 8 Science | Forces Acting on a Thrown Ball
text:

Water covers about 70% of Earth's surface and is essential for life. It's found in oceans, rivers, and even inside us.

Soil provides nutrients for plants to grow and supports both ecosystems and human life. It's part of the geosphere.

Geodiversity is the variety of landforms, rocks, and soils on Earth. It helps create unique habitats for different types of life.

All living beings depend on one another and their environment to survive and grow. Plants make food, animals eat plants, and decomposers recycle nutrients.

Destroying habitats can cause plants and animals to disappear, upsetting the balance of ecosystems. For example, if grasses vanish, animals that feed on them struggle to survive, and without herbivores, predators also lose their food source.
